name: israel

events.event: Israeli Culture Minister Miki Zohar threatened to revoke the citizenship of filmmakers Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor.
Israeli Culture Minister Miki Zohar accused the creators of the 'NAZA' documentary of a 'betrayal of the state' and self-loathing.
According to an NGO, Israel killed at least 1,107 Palestinians in attacks across the occupied West Bank between October 2023 and September 2026.
variants: 西岸死亡人数两个口径:至少 1,107——998379:9「Between October 2023 and September 2026, Israel killed at least 1,107 Palestinians in attacks across the occupied West Bank, the NGO said」;约 1,087——1001422:35「B'Tselem counted about 1,087 Palestinians killed by Israeli forces in the West Bank since October 2023, roughly a quarter of them children」。清单锁了 1,107,且抹掉了「at least / about」这两个约数限定。
1,107人(998379:9,原文归因于'the NGO said') vs 1,087人(1001422:35,原文归因于'B'Tselem counted about 1,087')——同一事实(西岸自2023年10月以来被以色列/以色列部队杀死的巴勒斯坦人数)在簇内存在两个不同数字口径。

trail.was: Israeli forces have killed 1,107 Palestinians in the West Bank since October 7, 2023.
trail.now: According to an NGO, Israel killed at least 1,107 Palestinians in attacks across the occupied West Bank between October 2023 and September 2026.
trail.why: 两处硬伤:一是两个数字都带 NGO 出处(the NGO said / B'Tselem counted),清单写成不带出处的既成事实,读者与判官无从知道这是统计口径而非官方数字;二是时间窗被改写——证据是 October 2023 至 September 2026 的区间,清单写成「since October 7, 2023」,10 月 7 日这个具体日期在本条的任何证据里都没有出现(987684:30 提的 7 October 2023 是加沙战争起点、对应的是另一组加沙伤亡数)。此外 1,107 只有一篇支持,簇内另有 1,087 的口径,已记入 conflictingFigures。
